summary: Backend E2E testing of NEET AI Question Generation Engine. Wrote pytest suite with 23 tests covering health, auth (admin/candidate/register/401), questions (meta, filters, seed RBAC, AI-generate via Gemini), blueprint CRUD + RBAC, exam creation with computed live status, future-exam join guard, paper forge (idempotent, 18 questions, 6 per subject, no duplicates), answer-key hiding in /paper, submit scoring (max=72, score = correct*4 + wrong*-1), already-submitted 400, /result reveals keys+explanation, /monitor stats and encrypted_payload projection, /monitor and /analytics RBAC. All 23 tests passed in 13s. AI generation succeeded (Gemini 3 Flash via Emergent LLM). Cleanup removes TEST_-prefixed exams/blueprints.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_exam response does not compute 'computed_status' like list_exams; consider unifying so single-exam UI shows live/scheduled/ended consistently.
submit_exam decrypts and iterates but does not enforce that exam is still within duration window; late submissions after end_ts are currently accepted.
join_exam maps 500 for missing blueprint; if a blueprint is deleted while an exam exists it will confuse clients. Consider referential integrity or 400.
seed_data_creation: Auto-registers a TEST_cand_<ts>@test.io candidate per run (not cleaned up - low volume). Creates TEST_-prefixed blueprints/exams and cleans them up in module teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is class-scoped for E2E state sharing (loadscope binds class to single xdist worker). AI generation currently works — if flaky, test auto-skips on 500. DB currently has >=180 seeded questions + a couple AI-generated Physics/Kinematics entries added per test run. Cleanup removes TEST_-prefixed blueprints/exams but not AI-inserted questions or TEST_ candidates.
